claims.claim: B is a service worker at a post office or parcel service counter
claims.mechanism: entailment from full transaction context: greeting, parcel sending request, delivery time inquiry, cost quote, and acceptance

evidence.quote: I want to send this parcel to Taiwan

claims.repair_of: B works at a post office or parcel service counter
claims.verifier_basis: A's request to send a parcel and questions about mail options/cost, followed by acceptance of B's quoted price, linguistically entail B occupies a service role at a parcel/post office counter. This is not merely a temporary transaction role but reflects B's occupational capacity (providing pricing, explaining service options).
